i.norm: Two JsonSetter.Value instances are unequal when one carries explicit AS_EMPTY null-handling and the other resolves to the empty (DEFAULT) value. A Value built from a JsonSetter whose nulls()/contentNulls() both return null is normalised by Value.from(...) to the EMPTY instance (Nulls.DEFAULT for both fields), which does not equal a Value explicitly set to AS_EMPTY.
Value with both value-nulls and content-nulls set to AS_EMPTY.
A JsonSetter annotation whose null-handling accessors both return null; Value.from() will normalise these nulls to Nulls.DEFAULT, yielding EMPTY.
The explicitly-constructed value retains its AS_EMPTY settings...
...so it differs from the normalised (DEFAULT/DEFAULT) empty value.
